description: This 102-acre property near Hubbard, Texas, offers a perfect blend of modern comforts and outdoor recreation, making it an ideal retreat for nature lovers and those seeking a peaceful, country lifestyle. The recently remodeled home features updated amenities, creating a cozy and contemporary space to relax. With spacious living areas, fresh finishes, and modern appliances, it’s a comfortable sanctuary amidst the natural beauty of the property. The land is a hunter’s paradise, with abundant wildlife including deer and hogs, making it ideal for hunting enthusiasts. Whether you're tracking game or simply soaking in the tranquil environment, the property provides ample opportunities for outdoor exploration and recreation. Pin Oak Creek meanders through the property, offering live water all or most of the year. The property also includes 2 ponds, ideal for fishing or simply enjoying the tranquil waters. Just steps from your back porch, enjoy the custom-built over-the-water party deck constructed across the pond, equipped with a lighted fountain. Both ponds are stocked with perch, bass and catfish. Located just a short drive from the town of Hubbard, this property provides the best of both worlds—privacy and seclusion, with easy access to local amenities. Whether you're looking to start a hobby farm, build your dream home, or simply enjoy weekend getaways, this property offers a wealth of possibilities in one of Texas' most scenic and accessible areas.
